title: Lexogen QuantSeq 3'mRNA FWD NGS Library Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange labware and load reagents
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT‑2 deck: NEST 0.1 mL 96‑well PCR plates (full skirt), Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack with 4×6 insert holding NEST 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes, Opentrons magnetic module, Opentrons temperature module with 4×6 aluminum block holding NEST 1.5 mL tubes, Opentrons P20 GEN2 single‑channel pipette, Opentrons P300 multi‑channel pipette, Opentrons 10/20 µL tiprack, Opentrons 50/300 µL tiprack. Load reagents into the tube rack (slot 2): tube A1 = RS, A2 = SS1, A3 = SS2. Load reagents into the aluminum block on the temperature module (slot 7): tube A1 = FS1, A2 = FS2/E1, A3 = PB, A4 = EB, A5 = PS, A6 = PCR/E3.

steps.title: Configure pipettes and sample count
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 app, specify the mount side for the P20 single‑channel pipette and the P300 multi‑channel pipette, and enter the total number of samples (up to 96) to be processed.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the Lexogen QuantSeq 3′ mRNA FWD NGS library‑prep protocol file (e.g., from the Lexogen website or the provided PDF link).

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 app, upload the downloaded protocol file to the robot.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Place each piece of labware on the deck positions indicated in the provided deck map (e.g., tube rack in slot 2, aluminum block on temperature module in slot 7, tipracks, magnetic and temperature modules as shown).

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tipracks, and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the OT‑2 calibration routine to calibrate the positions of all labware, tipracks, and both pipettes using the app’s calibration wizard.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 app to execute the QuantSeq library‑preparation protocol.
